name: llm-test-harness
description: LLM testing & evaluation framework on Playwright Test: YAML test cases, deterministic + heuristic + LLM-as-judge evaluators, metrics, reports and a CI quality gate.
author: Ghassen Azouz

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run validate && npm run test:unit && npm run test:llm
scripts.demo:regression: cross-env LLM_MOCK_RESPONSES=test_data/mock/responses.yaml,test_data/mock/faulty.yaml tsx src/cli.ts run || echo Expected: the quality gate rejected the regressed model
